subject.text: Mouse cursor jumps around by itself

description.text: When I move the mouse, the cursor stutters and then jumps to the corner of the screen.
The mouse cable is plugged in firmly and its sensor light is red.
When I flipped the mouse over, the sensor hole underneath was covered by a clump of dust and hair.
Does my computer have a virus?

history.text: Last week: this mouse worked normally in the routine test.

explanation: A clump of dust and hair covers the sensor hole, so the mouse misreads movement; it is not a virus. Fix it by cleaning the sensor, then test again.
hints: Don't jump to the virus guess. Look at the physical evidence on the mouse.
The mouse sensor reads the desk surface. What is blocking it?
